docs_landing_description: Build, test, package, sign and distribute high-trust GhostBoard plugins.
docs_landing_intro: GhostBoard plugins are ordinary JavaScript that you explicitly install and enable. These pages cover the four supported contribution types (commands, panels, custom canvas types and importers), the @ghostboard/sdk reference, packaging and signed updates, and the compatibility and support policy.
